title: 第一卷 第4章 她的腰-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    比起吹头发、按摩，这样的环抱动作无疑更加亲密。上官程的整个前胸都贴在霖多多的后背上，属于活人的温热感透过两层薄薄的衣料，一寸一寸地传递过来，暖得他心口发烫。

    他以为他会像从前无意中碰到别的女人时那样立刻应激、恶心、失控，浑身每个细胞都在叫嚣着逃离。

    可实际上，短暂的僵硬后他并没有产生太过强烈反应。

    最大的感触就是——好细。

    上官程知道霖多多瘦，但那只是视觉感受，真正触碰到才惊觉，竟瘦成这样。他的大掌随便一展就能握个来回。

    不过这种瘦，并非扶风弱柳似的纤弱，而是明显经过长期锻炼而产生的紧致，隔着衣料，他甚至能隐约摸到浅浅的腹肌线条，结实而有韧性，像一柄藏在鞘中的软剑。

    上官程垂下眼，看着身前这个瘦小却坚韧的背影，心里忽然生出一丝说不清道不明的情愫。

    他还没搞清这感觉是什么，就听霖多多突然说了句：

    “好痒。”

    上官程微怔：“什么...痒？”

    “当然是你摸得痒啊”，霖多多边说边向前挪了挪身子，“我说你的手，搂就搂，别在我肚子上乱戳乱动，挠到我痒痒肉了，影响骑车。”

    上官程猛然将手握拳：“抱歉！”他声音干涩，带着羞慌与不知所措。

    他刚才竟在摸人肚子？

    肯定是这具身体自带的bug导致的，他上官程才不会对一个女生的那种地方感兴趣。

    绝不会！

    ·

    又颠簸了几分钟，车终于停了。

    上官程以为二人抵达了目的地，抬眼一看，却是墓地。

    “姥姥、姥爷，我又来看你们了！”

    霖多多将车停在一旁的空地上，领着上官程到了那块合葬墓碑前，四周打扫的干干净净，还种着一圈可爱的小花。

    “这次有任务，时间紧，不能跟你们多聊。”面对二老，霖多多既没有跪，也没有拜，简单摆了几个小零食当祭品，状态随意的好似在串亲戚。

    她拍了拍身边的上官程，半开玩笑半认真道：“前段时间不是老托梦让我带个男友吗？瞧瞧这个怎么样？别的不说，起码够帅吧？”
    第(1/3)页

Compared to blow-drying or massaging your hair, this hugging action is undoubtedly more intimate.Shangguan Cheng's entire chest was pressed against Lin Duoduo's back, and the warmth of a living person passed through the two thin layers of clothing inch by inch, making his heart feel hot.

He thought he would be immediately stressed, nauseous, and out of control like he had been when he accidentally met another woman. Every cell in his body was screaming to escape.

But in fact, he didn’t react too strongly after a brief moment of stiffness.

The biggest feeling is - so detailed.

Shangguan Cheng knew that Lin Duoduo was thin, but that was just a visual experience. Only when he actually touched it did he realize that he was so thin.He can hold it back and forth with just a touch of his big palm.

" However, this kind of thinness is not as delicate as a weak willow in the wind, but is clearly tight and produced through long-term exercise. Through the clothes, he can even vaguely touch the shallow abdominal muscle lines, which are strong and tough, like a soft sword hidden in a sheath.

Shangguan Cheng lowered his eyes, looking at the thin but tough figure in front of him, and suddenly felt an indescribable emotion in his heart.

Before he could figure out what this feeling was, he heard Lin Duoduo suddenly say:

"It's so itchy."

Shangguan Cheng Wei was startled: "What... itches?"

"Of course it's because you feel itchy," Lin Duoduo said as he moved forward, "I told you to hold your hand, just hold it, don't poke and move around on my belly, it will scratch my itch, which will affect my riding."

Shangguan Cheng suddenly clenched his hand into a fist: "Sorry!" His voice was dry, filled with shame and confusion.

He was touching someone’s belly just now?

It must be caused by a bug inherent in this body. He, Shangguan Cheng, would not be interested in that kind of thing about a girl.

Absolutely not!

·

After a few minutes of bumping, the car finally stopped.

Shangguan Cheng thought they had arrived at their destination, but when he looked up, they saw it was a cemetery.

"Grandma, grandpa, I'm here to see you again!"

Lin Duoduo parked the car in an open space aside and led Shangguan Cheng to the tombstone for joint burial. The surrounding area was cleanly cleaned and there was a circle of cute little flowers planted there.

"I have a mission this time and I am short on time. I can't talk to you much." Facing the two elders, Lin Duoduo neither knelt nor bowed. He simply placed a few small snacks as sacrifices, as casually as if he was visiting relatives.

She patted Shangguan Cheng beside her and said, half jokingly and half seriously: "Didn't Lao Tuomeng ask me to bring a boyfriend some time ago? How about this? If nothing else, at least he is handsome enough, right?"
